title: Halogens and interhalogens
basic_overview: Halogens are oxidants; oxidising strength in aqueous media generally decreases F₂→I₂. Interhalogens show characteristic electron-domain geometries.

extra_info_content.short_trick: For redox, include X–X cleavage + electron gain + hydration, not just EN.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Write X₂ + 2e⁻→2X⁻. 2. Compare bond cleavage. 3. Include solvation. 4. For interhalogen count electron domains.
extra_info_content.factors: Fluorine is exceptional and does not normally show positive oxidation states.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
